text: The original meta-analysis reported a statistically significant reduction in coronary events with RR 0.65 (95% CI 0.50 to 0.85). After excluding the retracted and replaced PREDIMED trial under default policy, the recalculated effect was RR 0.50 (95% CI 0.34 to 0.72), which remains statistically significant with a larger effect size. Two studies remained in the analysis: de Lorgeril 1994 with no notices and Singh 2002 with an expression of concern. The verdict is HOLDS and the interpretation is CONCLUSION_SUPPORTED. An independent cross-check confirmed the recalculated RR 0.50 (95% CI 0.34 to 0.72) and agreed with the finding.
